notes: Primary coding profile. MTP reaches the full 262,144-token context on this 3090 (DFlash2 caps around 130k beside a desktop). context is left out, so --fit-context starts it at 262k when the card is free and degrades gracefully if something else is on the GPU. Two lanes so a couple of agents can run at once; vision (overlay) stays on for image input. Studio enabled, opens the browser.
